notes.title: 0.11.0 Update Patch Note
notes.content:
Added a new 7th stage to the game.
 Added 7 new Items.
 Added 2 new achievements.
 Added 1 new debuff status.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226962/0649a897b4ccfab593dc152e7abcb10293c43122.png

notes.title: 0.10.0 Update Patch Note
notes.content:
Added the Bronze, Silver and Gold keys that rarely appear in the dungeon. With a key in possession, opening a chest while having a full inventory may let you equip additional items.
 Re-ordered item IDs. Now, items obtainable from the 1st stage will be ID 1~7, 2nd stage 11~17, 3rd stage 21~27 and so on.
 Fixed an issue where the chests were too rare in stage 6.
 Some loot tables have been tweaked.
 Added 2 new achievements.
 Unobtained items will now show only their names in the Item dex.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226962/61663ac4f29f73c719cff8378e23861d00750e21.png"]

notes.title: 0.9.0 Update Patch Note
notes.content:
Added a new 6th stage to the game.
 Added 7 new Items.
 Added 2 new achievements.
 Save Data format has been renewed as preparation for future updates
 Languages can now be selected from the config screen.
 Added icons to some of the buttons in the config screen.
 Fixed a bug where Game Pads and Cursor were not usable in some of the screens.
 Enhanced Cursor UI element.
 Fixed a bug where projectile spread weren't calculated properly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226962/e5f16992bded43a55459ac94290c5b8c1d2d3902.png

notes.title: 0.7.0 Update Patch Note
notes.content:
Added a new 5th stage to the game.
 Added 7 new Items.
 You can now check the leaderboard in-game! Click the button on the bottom-left in the title screen.
 Improved Scrolling UI to move smoothly and allow gamepad inputs.
 Removed blocks will stay removed upon re-loading the game.
 Added 2 new achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226962/e477d2c0b0854e161174aee0cb278ce7d327cbce.png

notes.title: patch notes 0.6.1 ~ 0.6.5
notes.content:
0.6.5:

Fixed an issue where "completion" achievements were unobtainable. Visit the shop page while having at least one chest, and they should now be obtained.
Fixed a crushing bug  upon skipping tutorial.


0.6.4:

Salvage Balloon now shows description on click.
Fixed Salvage Balloon item not rendering correctly.


0.6.3

The game now pauses and mutes itself upon losing focus.
Fixed a bug where depth scores were not calculated correctly.
Fixed a crushing bug upon starting tutorial.


0.6.2

Changed Bomb and Safety Helmet item to not invoke on half-blocks.


0.6.1

Fixed a bug where equipment drop animation was also being played on salvage modes.

notes.title: 0.6.0 Update Patch Note
notes.content:
Added a new 4th stage to the game.
 Added 7 new Items.
 Added an animation showing your now lost items upon death.
 Added leaderboard. Click here to open leaderboard!
 Increased damage for some weapon items.
 Tweaked Enemy damage handling to allow simultaneous damages from multiple sources.
 Enhanced terrain generation.
 Minor bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226962/4d436fc88cef5bcbe9f1e2c64c7d1f3dc722172d.png

notes.title: 0.5.0 Update!
notes.content:
- 7 Achievements are now obtainable through normal gameplay.
- Players who hasn't played a tutorial yet will be prompted upon trying to start a dive.
- Fixed an issue where chests couldn't be trashed while in the dungeon.
- Minor bugfixes

notes.title: update 11/1
notes.content:
- Added support for Steam achievements
- Added tutorial
- Updated chest graphics
- Fixed some localization issues
